# gen.wav

> gen.wav is a trans Cuban-Nicaraguan-American singer, multi-instrumentalist, and producer from Miami, Florida — an openly transgender, LGBTQ+ Latino artist making Latin R&B and hip-hop in Spanish and English.

- Identity: trans man / transman / transmasc / transgender, LGBTQ+, Latino (Cuban and Nicaraguan heritage), Cuban-American, Nicaraguan-American
- Based in: Miami, Florida
- Genres: Latin R&B, hip-hop, with influences from salsa, bachata, reggaeton, jazz, and house
- Languages: Spanish and English (bilingual songwriting)
- Background: 10+ years of classical training (piano, cello, violin, voice, music theory); self-taught guitar, bass, and production
- Highlights: featured in Spotify editorial playlists and on COLORS; debut album GENESIS
